collection.title: BMW X7 2019 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW X7 2019 Onwards (G07) model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear wiper blade for this model, just click on the Rear Screen Wiper Blades tab below.

image.alt: BMW X7 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
